candidates.change_summary: Change the increment of imBalances[to] from adding creditsIssued to adding the raw mAssetAmount (so stored credits differ).
Subtract creditsIssued from imBalances[to] instead of adding it (flips sign of update).
Increase imBalances[msg.sender] (caller) by creditsIssued instead of imBalances[to], changing which key is modified.
Insert an extra increment of imBalances[to] by 1 (off-by-one change) in addition to the normal addition.
Modify the nonReentrant modifier to not set the _status to _ENTERED (removing the guard effect), which can alter reentrancy and thus imBalances updates observable after supplyTokenTo.
